bib.title: Swin Transformer: Hierarchical Vision Transformer using Shifted Windows

question: Can a Transformer be built as a general-purpose vision backbone that handles scale variation and high resolution, with cost linear in image size?
hypothesis: Hierarchical feature maps with shifted-window local self-attention give better accuracy/speed than global-attention ViT/DeiT and match or beat CNNs on classification, detection and segmentation.
contributions: Swin Transformer: hierarchical Transformer with patch merging and linear complexity via non-overlapping windows
Shifted window partitioning between consecutive blocks with cyclic-shift masked batch computation
State-of-the-art on COCO (58.7 box AP, 51.1 mask AP test-dev) and ADE20K (53.5 mIoU val), 87.3% ImageNet-1K top-1
Hierarchical design and shifted windows also help all-MLP (Swin-Mixer)

method.summary: Swin Transformer splits an image into 4x4 patches, runs 4 stages of window-attention blocks (W-MSA / SW-MSA alternating) with 2x2 patch merging between stages, and is used as backbone for classification (global average pool + linear), Cascade Mask R-CNN/HTC++ detection and UperNet segmentation.
method.task: image classification, object detection / instance segmentation, semantic segmentation

training.lr_schedule: IN-1K: cosine decay; IN-22K: linear decay; ADE20K: linear decay; COCO: decayed 10x at epochs 27 and 33 (3x) or 63 and 69 (6x)

limits: Speed: authors note their implementation uses built-in PyTorch functions not well-optimised, and ResNe(X)t uses highly optimised cuDNN; thorough kernel optimisation is out of scope.
No seeds, variances or significance tests; hardware for training not stated except 8 GPUs on ADE20K.
Training compute and wall-clock are not given.
Comparison tables mix 22K-pre-trained and 1K-only models and different test-time tricks (multi-scale *), so leaderboard gaps are not like for like.
DeiT-S in detection/segmentation needs deconvolution layers for hierarchical maps, which may disadvantage it.
Results are from 2021; later models have superseded the SOTA numbers.

terms.definition: multi-head self-attention modules with regular and shifted windowing configurations, respectively
concatenates the features of each group of 2x2 neighboring patches and applies a linear layer on the 4C-dimensional features, output dimension 2C
learnable bias B added to QK^T/sqrt(d) in each head, taken from a parameterised (2M-1)x(2M-1) table
